latestVersion.changelog:
Add Feishu (Lark) channel integration for NanoClaw

- Adds Feishu (Lark) as a new messaging channel using WebSocket – no ngrok or public URL required.
- Supports interactive setup, including automated code/app changes and environment configuration guidance.
- Works alongside WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, or as a standalone channel.
- Guides users through Feishu app creation, permissions, and registration of chat groups or direct chats.
- Provides troubleshooting, removal instructions, and details on JID formats.
